name: Microservices Architecture
forces_resolved: Independent deployability and autonomy of multiple feature teams
Fine-grained heterogeneous elasticity and tech-stack specialization
High fault isolation (single service crash does not bring down system)
forces_unresolved: Network latency and serialization overhead across distributed boundaries
Complex distributed data management (sagas, eventual consistency, CQRS)
Significant operational complexity (service meshes, Kubernetes, distributed tracing)
applicability_conditions: Large enterprise with multiple cross-functional teams (> 15 engineers)
Distinct domain boundaries with differing scale, security, or deployment cadence
Mature DevOps CI/CD and observability infrastructure in place
anti_requisites: Strict single-database immediate ACID transactions across all domains
Unclear, highly fluid domain boundaries (risk of distributed monolith)
